artworks.title: The Gardens of the Villa Medici
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows a preliminary sketch on light-colored paper. The sketch features finely detailed linework of trees with swirling strokes for leaves and branches. The horizon is not clearly defined, suggesting a landscape extending beyond. The brushstrokes are deliberate and controlled, with varied thicknesses for depth and texture. The color palette is muted, mainly beige paper and sepia ink. On the right side, there are two simpler sketches of furniture with faint, precise lines for contrast with the organic tree forms.

artworks.title: Monsieur Frère du Roi (The King's Brother)
artworks.artist: Antoine François Sergent after Joseph Siffred Duplessis
artworks.medium: wash manner, printed in blue, red, carmine, yellow, orange, green and black inks
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left, looking directly at the viewer. The man has white, wavy hair styled back and soft facial features with a slight smile. He wears a high-collared, elaborate silver coat with embroidered floral patterns, a blue vest, a decorative medal or insignia, and a cream-colored cravat. The portrait is framed with inscriptions and features a relief-style panel below it with cherubic figures and various objects, including a harp and a distant winged figure. The background is detailed and ornate, enhancing the historical and artistic theme of the portrait.

artworks.title: The Holy Angels Protecting a Hermit from Evils
artworks.medium: brown ink and gray wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (irregularly shaped): 26.5 x 15 cm (10 7/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene. It features an angelic figure seated on clouds in the upper portion, holding a scepter with wings extended. Surrounding this central figure are several smaller cherubic figures. The composition is framed by a decorative, curved outline. At the very top, there is an eye within a triangle surrounded by rays of light. The lower section depicts reclining figures. The limited color palette is dominated by brown inks and washes.

artworks.title: Louis XVI, Roi de France
artworks.artist: Pierre Adrien Le Beau after Benedict Alphonse Nicolet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a profile view facing right. He has detailed facial features with a prominent nose and full face. His hair is styled in an 18th-century fashion with curls and tied at the back with a ribbon. He is wearing a lavish garment with intricate patterns, a high collar, a sash across his shoulder embellished with a decorative tassel and a fur cape draped over his shoulder. The man also wears visible jewelry, including a decorative badge or medallion. The background is plain and textured, emphasizing the subject of the portrait.

artworks.title: Interior of a Roman Villa
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non after Hubert Robert
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 19.1 x 14.9 cm (7 1/2 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is an image of an interior scene with classical architecture and figures engaged in various activities. The scene includes a large, vaulted hall with a domed ceiling and arches. The walls are structured with rectangular stones and detailed architectural elements such as columns and entablatures. In the background, a pediment is supported by pillars. Within the composition, several draped figures are gathered around a central scene, with gestures hinting at interaction or ceremony. The use of chiaroscuro gives depth to the drawing, emphasizing the figures and architecture in harmonious tones.

artworks.title: Mr. de Voltaire
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a seated man identified as M. de Voltaire. He is angled towards the right side of the frame while engaged in writing or reading a document on a desk. His head is slightly bowed forward as he looks down at the papers, showcasing a profile with a prominent nose and distinct chin. The man wears a coat with fur trim and is adorned with a large, voluminous curly wig, topped by a hat with a folded brim. He appears focused on the task at hand, with his hands resting on the desk. The background is a simple wall with cross-hatched shading, and beside him, there are books and possibly a magnifying glass on the desk, with an elaborately carved chair partially visible behind him.

artworks.title: Kauernder weiblicher akt (Crouching Female Nude)
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint in black
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with their knees to their chest and arms wrapped around their legs. The individual has distinct facial features, short hair, and is nude. The background is a plain, textured surface. No accessories are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Frauenbildnis (Portrait of a Woman)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: This image shows an upper-body sketch of a person seated in a three-quarter view. The person is sitting upright with their hands resting on their lap in front of them, which is partially obscured by a loose-fitting robe or tunic. Their facial features are carefully drawn, with focused eyes, a straight nose, and lips set in a neutral expression. The hair is styled with a slight wave, cut to the level of the ears. The person is wearing a garment with wide sleeves and a high collar. The background is plain. The sketch is rendered in fine lines, emphasizing contours and shadows to define the form.

artworks.title: Stehende Weibliche akte (Standing Female Nude)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright, turned slightly to the side. They have short, dark, textured hair and distinct facial features. The person is nude with their right arm bent at the elbow and the hand raised, while the left arm appears to be in a similar position. The background is a plain, light color with sketchy, cross-hatched shading behind the figure. There is a signature in cursive handwriting at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Am see (On a Lake)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a structure that could be a barn or house. The perspective leads to the building located in the upper third of the composition. A line suggests the horizon, sloping away from the building. The painting shows dynamic brushstrokes indicating foliage, possibly trees, on the right side. The style is impressionistic with an emphasis on spontaneity over detail. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black on off-white paper. In the distance, there is a minimalistic representation of a roof and open land, enhancing the rural atmosphere.

artworks.title: In der hängematte II (In the Hammock II)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person reclining in a relaxed position with their head supported by a pillow. The person is covered by a blanket or draped cloth, and their facial features include a prominent nose and short beard, with short and dark hair. The background is plain with light shading and sketch marks emphasizing the focus on the person.

artworks.title: Pietà
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining nude figure on a cloth-covered surface. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to create depth and texture. The figure is positioned lying face down and slightly sideways, with arms and legs extended. The surface on which the figure lies appears to be made of stone or tiles, indicated by lines suggesting the joins between tiles.

artworks.title: Martyrium (Martyrdom)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows various interlocking lines and jagged shapes forming an abstract scene. Within the strokes, there are figures resembling human forms suggesting a gathering. The tallest figure is draped across a horizontal line, while other figures below appear to be kneeling or leaning. The scene is chaotic with dense hatching and cross-hatching creating texture and depth like an intricate sketch or drawing.

artworks.title: Arno Holz
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a monochromatic sketch of the upper half of a person, including their head and torso. The person is primarily forward-facing with their head slightly turned to one side in a gentle profile view. The sketch includes rough-textured features like eyes behind circular glasses, a prominent nose, and a closed mouth. Short, textured strokes depict the tousled hair, and the person wears a suit jacket with lapels and a hint of a shirt underneath. The figure is drawn in a loose, expressive style without intricate detailing, and there are no visible accessories or jewelry. The background is blank, emphasizing the focus on the sketched portrait.

artworks.title: A Man Overpowered By Thieves
artworks.medium: black ink and gray wash on buff laid paper
artworks.description: This is a monochromatic drawing depicting a group of figures in a rocky and natural environment. The figures are engaged in a dramatic scene, with some surrounding a reclining, undressed figure. The scene is intense and animated, with the landscape adding to the atmosphere. The drawing showcases fine lines, detailing, and shading to depict textures and depth in the artwork.

artworks.title: Oh Patrie!!!
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man walking with his arms crossed in front of his chest. He has a stern expression, a prominent jawline, and wears glasses, a hat, a long coat, and boots. Snow is falling heavily around him. The background shows a wintry urban scene with a building and snowy ground.

artworks.title: Tiens v'la peut-etre une pratique
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in an indoor setting. The main figure on the left is standing and wearing a long robe and a square cap, possibly a lawyer or academic. The person has a side profile view, a prominent nose, stern expression, and gray hair under the cap. They are holding an item under one arm. The second figure is being escorted by a third person in a uniform with a tall hat, guiding them by the arm. The background shows a partial wall and column.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Wisdom
artworks.medium: brown ink with gray and brown wash and white heightening over black chalk, squared for transfer in black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures surrounded by clouds. The image shows various figures interacting in graceful poses, some with wings and flowing clothing. The scene appears to depict a lively, otherworldly assembly with the figures engaging with each other. The clouds are depicted with soft, swirling lines, creating a sense of depth and ethereal atmosphere. Light and shadow within the clouds add dimensionality, while delicate inked outlines define the whimsical and serene nature of the illustration.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a woodland scene with trees, hills, lions, and a running watercourse. The detailed etching shows a dramatic sky with swirling clouds and fine lines capturing light and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and gray. Brushwork in the sky contrasts with bold strokes defining the landscape.

artworks.title: Two Monks with a Prostrate Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and added gray wash over black chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. One figure stands in the center, pointing with one hand. Another figure sits to the right, and a third figure lies on the ground to the left. The background is sketchy.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Isaac
artworks.medium: red chalk with white heightening on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two male figures in an intense interaction. The composition is in a monochrome reddish-brown medium, likely red chalk. One figure is bent forward with a determined expression, while the other is kneeling with his arms restrained behind him. The emphasis is on the anatomy and interaction of the two forms, in the style of Michelangelo.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical mythological scene set within rococo ornamentation. The scene depicts various figures in an outdoor setting surrounded by trees and cliffs. In the center, a group of elegantly dressed figures are engaged in conversation. Above them, ethereal figures float on clouds, one holding a symbol or crest. The foreground features objects resembling fruits or offerings. The scene is enclosed within an ornate rococo border.

artworks.title: Vierge à l'enfant sculptée par Geoffroy-Dechaume, chantier de la cathédrale Notre-Dame, Paris (Madonna and Child, sculpted by Geoffroy-Dechaume, Notre-Dame Cathedral, Paris)
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a woman holding an infant in her left arm. The woman wears a crown and flowing robes, holding a scroll in her right hand. The child appears wrapped in cloth. The material seems to be stone or marble, with a light color that accentuates the craftsmanship details. The sculpture is placed outdoors, surrounded by wood and stones. Stone figures are partially visible in the background. Both figures have calm expressions, conveying a timeless and stable presence.

artworks.title: Amerapoora: East Door of the Maha-thugea-yan-tee Pagoda
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a temple facade. There is a large entrance at the center, adorned with intricate carvings and relief patterns. Steps lead up to arched doorways, flanked by statues of mythical creatures. The temple extends laterally with multiple smaller arches and decorative spires. The stone surface appears weathered. The temple is set against a clear sky.
